name: Exp_UltraAbsolutelyNoLagLwma
summary: This EA is based on the Ultra Absolutely No Lag LWMA (Linearly Weighted Moving Average) indicator, which uses a zero-lag weighting scheme to generate trading signals. It enters long positions when the no-lag LWMA turns upward and short positions when it turns downward, aiming to capture trend movements with minimal indicator delay. The system applies a systematic trend-following approach with configurable period and signal confirmation parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Ultra Absolutely No Lag LWMA（无滞后线性加权移动平均）指标，采用零滞后加权方案生成交易信号。当无滞后LWMA向上转折时做多，向下转折时做空，旨在以最小指标延迟捕捉趋势运动。该系统采用系统化的趋势跟踪方法，具有可配置的周期和信号确认参数。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于零滞后线性加权移动平均线(LWMA)的方向变化来判断趋势转折点。入场条件为：当无滞后LWMA从下降转为上升时开多单，当从上升转为下降时开空单，利用指标斜率变化作为信号触发。出场条件通常依赖于反向信号出现时平仓，即多单在LWMA转向下时平仓，空单在LWMA转向上时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA提供固定手数输入参数，允许交易者根据账户规模调整仓位大小。资金管理方面，EA可能包含止损和止盈参数设置，但核心依赖指标反转信号作为主要出场机制。整体策略属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，优点是减少了传统移动平均线的滞后性，但仍然存在震荡行情中频繁假信号的问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on directional changes of the zero-lag Linearly Weighted Moving Average (LWMA) to identify trend reversal points. Entry conditions: open a long position when the no-lag LWMA turns from declining to rising, and open a short position when it turns from rising to declining, using the indicator slope change as the signal trigger. Exit conditions typically rely on opposing signals — long positions close when the LWMA turns downward, and short positions close when it turns upward. Position sizing is handled through a fixed lot size input parameter, allowing traders to adjust the position based on their account size. Money management may include stop-loss and take-profit parameters, but the core exit mechanism depends primarily on the indicator reversal signal. Overall, this is a classic trend-following system that benefits from reduced lag compared to traditional moving averages, but still suffers from frequent false signals during choppy or range-bound market conditions.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (used when money management is disabled)

parameters.name: Stop_Loss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: Take_Profit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于区分不同EA的订单

pros: 使用零滞后加权方案减少了传统移动平均线的延迟问题，使信号更及时
系统化的趋势跟踪逻辑清晰易懂，入场和出场规则明确
基于LWMA加权方式对近期价格赋予更高权重，比简单移动平均更能反映市场当前状态
pros_en: The zero-lag weighting scheme significantly reduces the delay problem of traditional moving averages, making signals more timely
Systematic trend-following logic is clear and easy to understand, with well-defined entry and exit rules
LWMA weighting assigns higher weight to recent prices, better reflecting current market conditions than simple moving averages
cons: 在震荡行情中会产生大量假信号导致频繁亏损，趋势跟踪策略的固有缺陷
缺乏趋势强度过滤器（如ADX），无法区分强趋势和弱趋势环境
止损和止盈默认设为0意味着没有风险保护，完全依赖反向信号出场可能造成较大亏损
cons_en: Generates numerous false signals during choppy/ranging markets leading to frequent losses, an inherent flaw of trend-following strategies
Lacks a trend strength filter (e.g., ADX), unable to distinguish between strong and weak trend environments
Default stop-loss and take-profit set to 0 means no risk protection; relying entirely on reversal signals for exit can cause significant losses
improvements: 增加趋势强度过滤器（如ADX或ATR）来避免在震荡行情中交易
添加移动止损机制以锁定盈利，减少盈利回吐
加入时间过滤和波动率过滤，避免在低流动性时段和高点差时段交易
improvements_en: Add a trend strength filter (e.g., ADX or ATR) to avoid trading during choppy/ranging market conditions
Implement a trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits and reduce profit givebacks
Add time and volatility filters to avoid trading during low-liquidity sessions and high-spread periods

risk_points: 默认止损为0，没有硬性风险保护措施，可能导致单笔大额亏损
纯趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中会连续亏损，缺乏市场状态识别机制
没有新增K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上反复开仓平仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss is 0 with no hard risk protection, potentially leading to large single-trade losses
Pure trend-following strategy will incur consecutive losses in ranging markets, lacking market regime identification
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening and closing positions repeatedly on the same bar
